<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_StorageManagement"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderProcessing" name="Start">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_ReadOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_ReadOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckStock" name="Check if product is in stock" default="Flow_NotInStock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InStock</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Withdraw_MergeProductHandling</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitForArrival" name="Wait for product to arrive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Arrival_RegisterProduct</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_DeliveryDelay" name="More than 10 days waiting" attachedToRef="Task_WaitForArrival" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Delay_DemandPenalty</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_DeliveryDelay">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P10D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Demand delivery delay penalty">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Delay_DemandPenalty</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DemandPenalty_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PenaltyDemanded" name="Penalty demanded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DemandPenalty_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Arrival_RegisterProduct</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Register_MergeProductHandling</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeProductHandling" name="Continue order processing">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Withdraw_MergeProductHandling</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Register_MergeProductHandling</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_CheckOrderReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CheckOrderReady" name="Check if whole order is ready for shipment" default="Flow_OrderNotReady">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_CheckOrderReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderReady</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OrderNotReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderNotReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReadySplit" name="Proceed with shipment tasks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OrderReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ready_RequestCourier</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ready_PackProducts</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ready_RequestCourier</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ready_PackProducts</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderShipped" name="Order shipped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Ship_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderProcessing" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Gateway_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckStock" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">inStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckStock" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_MergeProductHandling" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_MergeProductHandling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_WaitArrival" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Task_WaitForArrival"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrival_RegisterProduct" sourceRef="Task_WaitForArrival" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Delay_DemandPenalty" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_DeliveryDelay" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DemandPenalty_End" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="EndEvent_PenaltyDemanded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_MergeProductHandling" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_MergeProductHandling"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_CheckOrderReady" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeProductHandling" targetRef="Gateway_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady" name="Order ready for shipment" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ReadySplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderReady</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady" name="Order not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Gateway_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadySplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ready_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadySplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_ShipmentJoin" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_ShipmentJoin" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipmentJoin_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderShipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderManagementSystem" name="Automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StockManagementSystem" name="Stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderToStorage" sourceRef="Participant_OrderManagementSystem" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderToWholesaler" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_WholesalerArrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Task_WaitForArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PenaltyToWholesaler" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RegisterInStockSystem" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Participant_StockManagementSystem"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
